The range

The range, in light.

A selection from the current site. Colours, material groups and sizes are on each product page. Samples can be sent on request.

  • 01

    Light-filtering roller

    Blocks out glare and lets a little soft light gently filter through.

    See in the lab
  • 02

    Block-out roller

    Superior shading that safeguards furniture from sun damage. Bedrooms and boardrooms.

    See in the lab
  • 03

    Curti Voile

    Flowing fabric vanes that allow both light and privacy. Walk straight through them.

    See in the lab
  • 04

    Shade Weave

    Reduces heat and glare while allowing the desired level of natural light in.

    See in the lab
  • 05

    Day / Night

    Control the sun’s glare by day and keep your privacy at night: shade weave plus block-out.

    See in the lab
  • 06

    Zebra

    Stripes of translucent and opaque fabric. Stop the blind where you like for an open or closed effect.

  • 07

    Honeycomb

    Double-celled to trap air, for heat and sound insulation. Opens from the bottom or the top.

  • 08

    Roman

    Non-stitch groove system: straight folds and clean horizontal lines.

  • 09

    Venetian

    Tilt the slats to steer the light and the privacy.

  • 10

    Bamboo roller

    Bamboo, rattan, jute, grass and reeds: rich natural textures and colours.

  • 11

    Panel blinds

    For sliding doors and larger windows, in material or bamboo.

  • 12

    Outdoor Shade Weave

    Manages heat and glare on your patio while maintaining your view.
